What is a sample space?: Probability of an event with equally likely outcomes?
\( P(E) = |E| / |S| \): outcomes in the event over all outcomes.
\( P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) \).
\( P(A \cap B) / P(B) \): the share of \( B \) that is also \( A \).
\( P(H \mid E) = P(E \mid H) P(H) / P(E) \).

What is a sample space?: Easiest way to do Bayes by hand?
Imagine a crowd (for example 10,000) and count each branch instead of multiplying percentages.
A function that attaches a number to each outcome.

What is a sample space?: Expected value of a discrete \( X \)?
\( E[X] = \sum x P(X=x) \): the balance point of the distribution.
\( E[X+Y] = E[X] + E[Y] \), even for dependent \( X, Y \).

What is a sample space?: Expected tries until first success with chance \( p \)?
Central Limit Theorem in one line?
Averages of many independent pieces are approximately normal, with spread shrinking like \( 1/\sqrt{n} \).

What is a sample space?: What is a stationary distribution of a Markov chain?
A distribution \( \pi \) with \( \pi P = \pi \): the long-run share of time in each state.
\( L = \lambda W \): average number in system = arrival rate x average time in system.
